result.summary: Found 1 notable layout issue: the bottom navigation bar is overlapping the content feed, partially hiding the next restaurant card and making the page feel cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar sits on top of the scrolling content, so the next card in the list is partially obscured behind the navigation area.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so items can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.
